name: Celestial Maiden
description:
The form that the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus crave. A true appearance that cast off the burdens of humanity and has been reforged using the way of immortality.
In ancient times, those who sought immortality received wisdom from the Ambrosial Arbor and called themselves Celestials. They lived without restraints and molded the flesh of themselves and others at will. They have long forgotten their original appearances after countless metamorphoses.

skills.name: Rite of Great Arbor Metamorphosis
skills.description: Continuously deal Wind DMG to one random target, with a high chance to cause Wind Shear to attacked targets.

skills.name: Guiding Vulturnus
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets, with a high chance to cause Wind Shear to attacked targets.

skills.name: Arboreal Thorns
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to one designated target, with a high chance to cause Wind Shear to attacked targets.

skills.name: Black Prana's Snare
skills.description: Has a high chance for all targets to become afflicted with the "Prana-Siphon" state.

skills.name: Vitals Drained
skills.description: When friendly units attack targets in the "Prana-Siphon" state, the DMG dealt by this instance of attack will be converted to the extent of Max HP reduced by "Prana-Siphon," and refresh "Prana-Siphon's" duration. "Prana-Siphon" can reduce Maximum Restorable HP by up to <unbreak>99%</unbreak>.
